gates.name: Complexity pilot
gates.rule: IDP-v5, TD3, C1 (fixed d=1 + queue), MLP dnn, seeds 1-3, budgets 150k/300k/500k env steps. A seed is 'learned' at a budget if its final avg-100 training return >= 8190 (90% of 9100). GB0 passes if >=2/3 seeds are learned at some budget; B1's budget is the smallest passing budget. Reported: eval last-5, steps to first avg-100 >= 8190, extrapolated TRM / TRM H=1 walltime at the chosen budget.

gates.name: Kill switch
gates.detail: 150k: 0/3 learned (finals [1101.1, 954.0, 1708.2]); 300k: 0/3 learned (finals [1729.6, 1855.6, 1790.4]); 500k: 0/3 learned (finals [1418.0, 2805.3, 2201.3]). No budget passes. Hopper rung dropped by the author (K-2).
gates.rule: If GB0 has not passed by 2026-10-09, run the same pilot on Hopper-v5 + TD3 (learned >= 3420 = 90% of 3800). If that fails too, Stage B stops and is reported to the author.

gates.name: LR sensitivity
gates.detail: No cell beats x1/x1 by more than the pooled SD in 3/3 seeds: TRM insensitive to LR within x0.3-x3. Medians: a0.3c0.3 -223.85, a0.3c1 -234.79, a0.3c3 -245.59, a1c0.3 -250.41, a1c1 -215.12, a1c3 -208.79, a3c0.3 -261.45, a3c1 -270.82, a3c3 -244.75
gates.rule: Pendulum-v1, DDPG, C1 (Stage 1 condition, no prev action), trm 788k H=3, 200 episodes, actor x critic LR multipliers {0.3,1,3}^2, seeds 1-3. For each non-default cell and seed s: D(s) = final(cell,s) - final(x1/x1,s). A cell is flagged if D(s) > pooled seed SD of the two cells for all 3 seeds. Any flag -> report to the author (who decides on rerunning Stage 1's trm - dnn_large contrast at that LR); none -> 'TRM insensitive to LR within x0.3-x3'.

gates.name: Training discipline
gates.detail: trm_fullgrad - trm | C1: median +2.5, 3/6; trm_fullgrad - trm | C4: median +10.1, 4/6; trm_fullgrad_ds - trm | C1: median +0.3, 3/6; trm_fullgrad_ds - trm | C4: median +28.4, 4/6. No contrast reaches 5/6.
gates.rule: Pendulum-v1, DDPG, 200 episodes, C1 and C4 with prev_action_obs=true, seeds 1-6. Arms: trm (TRM-trunc), trm_fullgrad, trm_fullgrad_ds, all with the frozen clip norms; dnn unclipped. For D in {trm_fullgrad, trm_fullgrad_ds} and c in {C1, C4}: per-seed D - TRM-trunc. GA passes if any of the four contrasts is positive in >=5/6 seeds (one-sided p=0.109 each; the passing contrast is named). Secondary: D - dnn per condition; late (last-quarter) critic-loss ratios; eval last-5; latency; training cost within GPU model.

gates.name: G1 under TD3
gates.detail: trm - dnn_large under TD3: median -1214.95, negative in 12/12 pairs (two-sided p=0.00048828125). trm_small - dnn: -152.53 (0/12 positive); dnn_large - dnn: -2.73 (2/12 positive); trm - trm_small: -669.48 (3/12 positive) CAVEAT (reported, status unchanged): the pass reflects an optimisation failure, not a Phase-3-sized deficit. Under td3.yaml, TRM 788k stays at random-policy level in 10/12 seeds (final avg-100 about -1390; critic loss rises from ~100 to ~700 over training, i.e. the critic diverges), while every MLP seed learns (about -172). TRM 136k learns in 9/12 seeds (median -321). trm - trm_small is -669 (3/12): the larger TRM fails more often. Likely contributor, untested: td3.yaml's actor lr 1e-3 is 10x the DDPG actor lr, and Stage C showed raising TRM's actor lr hurts it.
gates.rule: Pendulum-v1, TD3 with conf/arch/td3.yaml unchanged (warmup 10000 steps, lr 1e-3/1e-3, batch 256), 200 episodes, conditions {no delay, C1 = fixed d=1 + queue, no prev action}, trunks dnn, dnn_large, trm_small, trm, seeds 1-6 (48 jobs; mirrors Phase 3 Stage 1). Pairs = (seed, condition), n=12. GT passes (G1 reproduces under TD3) if trm - dnn_large final avg-100 is negative in >=10/12 pairs (two-sided sign-test p reported). Secondary, reported whatever the outcome: trm_small - dnn, dnn_large - dnn, trm - trm_small (G1's other contrasts, 'different' = >=10/12 share a sign); late critic-loss ratios at matched capacity; eval last-5; TD3-vs-DDPG side by side with Phase 3 Stage 1. Note: under TD3 each trunk's parameter count includes twin critics, so '788k'/'135k' name the DDPG-basis configs.

gates.name: Complexity scaling (H1')
gates.detail: Author decision 2026-10-08: B1 is not run, so H1' is not evaluated. Reasons: (1) no rung above Pendulum was learned by the MLP baseline under the pre-registered conditions (GB0 fail on IDP; KB0 fail on Hopper; the K-2 diagnostic showed C1 at 1M steps still 0/3 learned, with the one-step delay the main obstacle, since without delay every seed reached 8190 at some point); (2) Stage T showed TRM 788k does not train under td3.yaml even on Pendulum (2/12 seeds learn; the critic diverges), so a TD3 B1 on IDP would most likely measure that optimisation failure, not complexity scaling, and Stage T could not serve as the H1' reference. The draft exploratory K-3 (phase4/plan/K-3_draft.md) is superseded. H1 (complexity scaling) remains untested for the project.
gates.rule: delta_E(s) = [final_dnn(s) - final_trm(s)] / span_E, span_E = best_E - untrained_E (untrained = uniform-random actions, 100 episodes, C1 wrapper; best = highest final avg-100 in the comparison set: Stage 1 fixed1-aug runs on Pendulum, all B1 runs on the new rung). Pendulum: Phase 3 Stage 1 dnn/trm fixed1-aug seeds 1-6 (DDPG). New rung: B1 dnn/trm seeds 1-6 (TD3). H1' supported only if delta_new(s) < delta_Pendulum(s) in >=5/6 seed pairs. Secondary: same for trm vs dnn_large and trm_h1 vs dnn. Threats: algorithm differs across rungs; cross-environment seed pairing is arbitrary.

gates.name: Lipschitz mechanism (exploratory)
gates.rule: Phase 3 Stage 1 checkpoints: spectral norm of da/ds over states of 20 deterministic eval episodes (median, p95 per checkpoint); Spearman correlation with reversals/s and sensor-noise (sigma=0.05) return drop. Exploratory.

gates.name: Does actor LR explain TRM's TD3 failure?
gates.detail: trm|1e-4: 12/12 learned (median -187.69); trm|3e-4: 11/12 learned (median -234.56); trm|1e-3: 2/12 learned (median -1389.27); dnn_large|1e-4: 12/12 learned (median -176.14); dnn_large|1e-3 (Stage T): 12/12 learned (median -175.92). trm@1e-4 - dnn_large@1e-4: median -12.98, 2/12 positive, two-sided p=0.0386 [LR-matched (primary)]; trm@3e-4 - dnn_large@1e-4: median -53.6, 0/12 positive, two-sided p=0.0005 [unequal actor LRs (TRM 3e-4 vs MLP 1e-4)].
gates.rule: Pendulum-v1, TD3 (td3.yaml; only arch.actor_lr overridden), conditions C0 (no delay) and C1 (fixed d=1 + queue, no previous action), seeds 1-6, 200 episodes. TRM 788k at actor LR in {1e-4, 3e-4, 1e-3}; MLP 788k (dnn_large) at actor LR 1e-4 as a control. Per LR, report runs learned (final avg-100 > -1000) out of 12. 'LR explains the TD3 failure' if TRM 788k learns in >=10/12 runs at some actor LR < 1e-3. If it does, also report TRM 788k - MLP 788k (actor LR 1e-4) at that LR: n = 12 (seed, condition) pairs, sign test, two-sided p. If both 1e-4 and 3e-4 pass, report both contrasts; the 1e-4 contrast is LR-matched and primary, the 3e-4 one compares unequal actor LRs and is labelled so. Secondary: late critic-loss medians (last quarter), eval last-5, MLP 788k learned count vs Stage T's MLP 788k at actor LR 1e-3.

amendments.text: Stage A MLP reuse check (plan §6) passed: DDPG + dnn at C1 and C4 with prev_action_obs trained bit-identically (final-weight hash + full episode history, CPU, 2 episodes) under Phase 3's frozen p3code/s2 snapshot and the Phase 4 tree; Hydra overrides differ only in logging fields (record_every, print_stat_every, output folders). Stage A reuses results_p3s2 dnn C1/C4 seeds 1-6; the 12 MLP jobs are not rerun.

untrained_E frozen for the H1' span (plan §7): Pendulum-v1 -1163.84, InvertedDoublePendulum-v5 49.90, Hopper-v5 16.32 (uniform-random policy). Note: Phases 1-3 quoted 'about -1460' for an untrained Pendulum policy (a learned-nothing actor, not random actions); the pre-registered random-policy definition is used for both rungs.

Plan §5 verification passed before any B0/C/A job: (1) gradient-hook test 7/21 cell applications receive gradient truncated, 21/21 with full_grad (also H=1: 7/7, H=6: 7/42 vs 42/42); (2) 30/30 existing configurations (DDPG+TD3 x 12 trunks at fixed d=1+queue, DDPG x {dnn,trm,trm_carryz} at no delay and C4+prev action) bit-identical in final weights and episode history between the pre-Phase-4 snapshot (= p3code/s2x) and the Phase 4 tree; (3) clip=inf reproduces the unclipped run exactly, trm_fullgrad/_ds train, total_steps stops at budget; (4) GPU smoke job (V100) passed. Outputs in experiments/phase4/verification/.

Stage A clip norms frozen from the a0 pilot per plan §6: actor 15, critic 2800 (clip_grad_norm_, per network, all three TRM arms; MLP unclipped). Pilot would-clip fractions: TRM-trunc 0.5-1.5% actor / 0.7-1.2% critic; full-gradient arms ~3% actor / 0.4% critic. Author approved the Stage A matrix (36 TRM jobs; MLP reused per R-1) with clipping, noting that all earlier runs (Phases 1-3, B0, C) were unclipped, so clipped TRM arms are compared against each other for GA and secondary comparisons against the unclipped MLP and Phase 3 carry that difference.

Kill switch KB0 fired on 2026-10-07 (day 2) by the author after GB0 failed (0/3 learned at every budget on IDP-v5). Hopper-v5 + TD3 pilot as pre-registered: same budgets (150k/300k/500k), seeds 1-3, MLP dnn, C1; learned threshold unchanged at 3420 (90% of the registry's 3800). conf/env/hopper.yaml added (id Hopper-v5, max_steps 1000), new file only.

Author decision after GB0 and KB0 failed. (1) Hopper rung dropped. (2) IDP-v5 diagnostic, stage b0d, results_p4b0d: TD3, MLP dnn, seeds 1-3, (a) C1 (fixed d=1 + queue) at 1M env steps; (b) no delay at 500k. Reported against the unchanged 8190 bar with learning curves; no gate of its own. (3) After it, a draft K-3 goes to the author before any B1 data: B1 confirmatory at 1M if 1M passes GB0's rule (>=2/3 seeds >= 8190); otherwise B1 exploratory at the best budget with 'learned' replaced by a pre-stated 'clear of floor' criterion, H1' labelled exploratory.

Stage T added by the author: the Phase 3 Stage 1 capacity contrast under TD3, to address the single-algorithm threat. Design fixed with the author before data: both Stage 1 conditions (no delay + C1) so the gate pools 12 pairs as G1 did; td3.yaml as-is (same TD3 settings as B0/B1, no tuning for any trunk; its 10k-step warmup is 50 of 200 Pendulum episodes for every arm).

Author decision 2026-10-08: B1 is not run, so H1' is not evaluated. Reasons: (1) no rung above Pendulum was learned by the MLP baseline under the pre-registered conditions (GB0 fail on IDP; KB0 fail on Hopper; the K-2 diagnostic showed C1 at 1M steps still 0/3 learned, with the one-step delay the main obstacle, since without delay every seed reached 8190 at some point); (2) Stage T showed TRM 788k does not train under td3.yaml even on Pendulum (2/12 seeds learn; the critic diverges), so a TD3 B1 on IDP would most likely measure that optimisation failure, not complexity scaling, and Stage T could not serve as the H1' reference. The draft exploratory K-3 (phase4/plan/K-3_draft.md) is superseded. H1 (complexity scaling) remains untested for the project.

Author approved reuse: the TRM 788k arm at actor LR 1e-3 is Phase 4 Stage T's 12 TRM 788k runs (phase4/results/results_p4t), same td3.yaml configuration, code verified byte-identical to the frozen p4code/t snapshot. Caveat: runs are not bit-reproducible across GPU models. Stage T2 therefore submits 36 jobs (TRM at 1e-4 and 3e-4, MLP 788k control at 1e-4).

log.text: GT2: LR explains the TD3 failure. TRM 788k learned 12/12 @1e-4, 11/12 @3e-4, 2/12 @1e-3; TRM − MLP 788k @1e-4 = −13.0 (2/12, p=0.039)

findings.note: Pendulum, DDPG, 6 seeds, clip actor 15 / critic 2800 on TRM arms; MLP reused from Phase 3 (R-1). Final avg-100 medians; Δ vs truncated TRM with k/6 positive. Source: analysis_p4_a.json.

findings.title: Stage T · G1 under TD3 (GT pass, with caveat)
findings.note: Pendulum, TD3 (td3.yaml unchanged), {no delay, C1} × seeds 1–6. Median final avg-100 over 12 runs. TRM 788k stays at random level in 10/12 seeds and its critic loss rises through training (diverges), so the 12/12 pass is an optimisation failure, not a Phase-3-sized deficit. DDPG = Phase 3 Stage 1 for comparison. Source: analysis_p4_t.json.

findings.title: Stage C · LR sweep (GC: insensitive)
findings.note: TRM 788k, Pendulum, DDPG, C1, 3 seeds per cell. Median final avg-100; default ×1/×1 is −215. No cell beats it by more than the pooled SD in 3/3 seeds. Source: analysis_p4_c.json.

findings.title: IDP diagnostic (K-2): MLP, TD3
findings.note: Final avg-100 per seed (bar 8190); in brackets the best avg-100 reached at any point. C1 plateaus with collapse/recovery cycles (20–48% of episodes solved per 100k); without delay every seed reaches the bar at some point (106k–249k steps) but does not hold it. Source: analysis_p4_b0d.json.

findings.title: Stage B0 · complexity pilots (GB0, KB0 fail)
findings.note: MLP, TD3, C1, final avg-100 per seed. IDP bar 8190 (90% of 9100); Hopper bar 3420 (90% of 3800). IDP episodes are bimodal: 32–45% full solves at 500k. Hopper rung dropped (K-2). Source: analysis_p4_b0.json, analysis_p4_b0h.json.

findings.title: Stage D · embedded export
findings.note: Seed-1 Stage 1 actors exported to float32 C headers with 20 reference I/O pairs each (phase4/results/export_c/). INT8 = 1 byte per weight + one float32 scale per tensor.

findings.title: Latency and cost (Stage A arms)
findings.note: Actor forward, batch 1, 1 CPU thread on the local workstation, which is 2.3× (TRM) to 3.6× (MLP) slower at p99 than the Phase 3 Katana Xeon; compare ratios only. full_grad / deep_sup change training only.

findings.title: Stage E · actor Lipschitz (exploratory)
findings.note: Spectral norm of ∂a/∂s over the plant observation, at the 4000 states of 20 deterministic battery episodes per checkpoint (TRM via its untruncated forward). 72 Phase 3 Stage 1 checkpoints, 12 per trunk; medians per trunk. Noise drop = nominal IQM − IQM at σ = 0.05. Spearman ρ, Lipschitz vs reversals: −0.24 all, −0.59 MLP, −0.40 TRM; vs noise drop: +0.06, +0.18, +0.23. Source: analysis_p4_e.json.

summary.status: Phase 4 complete · all gates resolved · final documents written · 2026-10-08
summary.verdict: Within the settings tested, TRM's weight-tied recursion brings no consistent benefit as a model-free actor-critic trunk. Capacity, depth, memory, tuning and TRM's own training discipline have each been ruled out as the reason; under TD3's standard settings it is harder still to train. Use the MLP.
summary.question: Does weight-tied recursion (TRM), used as the actor-critic trunk of a model-free RL agent, benefit continuous control under action delay — and if not, why not?

items.q: Is there a harder task the MLP learns, where TRM's deficit shrinks?
items.finding: IDP with a 1-step delay: MLP 0/3 learned at 150k–1M steps (best final 4312 vs 8190). Hopper: best 2805 vs 3420. Without delay IDP is learnable but not held: the delay is the obstacle.
3×3 actor × critic LR grid: no cell beats the default (−215) by more than the pooled SD in 3/3 seeds. Higher actor LR hurts.

items.q: Does TRM's own training discipline rescue it?
items.finding: Full gradient (21/21 applications) ± per-cycle critic supervision: best 4/6 vs truncated TRM; 1/6 vs the MLP. 1.45–1.5× the training cost.

items.q: Does the G1 attribution hold under a second algorithm (TD3)?
items.finding: TRM 788k − MLP 788k negative 12/12 (p = 0.0005) — but because TRM 788k fails to train under td3.yaml (2/12 seeds learn; critic diverges). MLPs train as under DDPG.

items.q: Complexity scaling on the harder rung (H1′)
items.finding: Skipped by the author (K-3): no harder rung learnable by the baseline, and TRM 788k does not train under the same TD3 settings. H1 stays untested — a limitation, not evidence against TRM.

items.q: Is TRM's noise sensitivity a sharper input–output map?
items.finding: TRM actors have lower local Lipschitz constants than MLPs (11–16 vs 29–34) yet lose 1.6–3× more return under sensor noise.

items.q: Do the actors fit a 512 KB microcontroller?
items.finding: MLP 135k and TRM 136k: ~265 KB FP32 (fit). TRM H=1: 1.54 MB FP32, 386 KB INT8 (INT8 only). Headers in phase4/results/export_c/.

changes: Holds. Not tuning (GC), not the training discipline (GA); direction also holds under TD3 (GT, via optimisation failure).
Restoring the training discipline is the remaining route to a positive
TD3 and an unstable plant are open
TD3 tested (GT, caveat). The baseline cannot learn the unstable plant reliably with delay.
Still untested: two more rungs failed the baseline.

phase5.question: Does TD3's 10× higher actor learning rate explain why TRM 788k failed to train in Stage T?
phase5.design: Pendulum-v1, TD3 (td3.yaml, only actor LR overridden), no delay + fixed 1-step delay, seeds 1–6. TRM 788k at actor LR 1e-4 and 3e-4 (12 runs each); its 1e-3 arm reuses Stage T's 12 runs (amendment P5-1). Control: MLP 788k at actor LR 1e-4. 36 new jobs, ~42 min per TRM run.
phase5.gate: GT2: 'LR explains the TD3 failure' if TRM 788k learns (final avg-100 > −1000) in ≥ 10/12 runs at some actor LR < 1e-3; then TRM − MLP at that LR (n = 12, sign test).
phase5.baseline: Stage T (actor LR 1e-3): TRM 788k learned 2/12; MLP 788k 12/12.
